questions.solution:

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equations will be correct?

× and +
questions.solution:
By interchanging the given two signs × and + then,

1) 6 × 11 + 13 ÷ 11 = 17

6 + 11 × 13 ÷ 11 = 17

6 + 13 = 17

19 = 17 (False)

2) 4 + 9 × 11 ÷ 3 = 37

4 × 9 + 11 ÷ 3 = 37

4 × 9 + 3.67 = 37

36 + 3.67 = 37

39.67 = 37 (False)

3) 11 × 6 ÷ 18 + 54 = 29

11 + 6 ÷ 18 × 54 = 29

11 + 18 = 29

29 = 29 (True)

So, option 3 is true therefore no need to check the other options.

Thus, the correct answer is “11 × 6 ÷ 18 + 54 = 29”.

questions.question: A alone can do a piece of work in 30 days. B alone can do the same work in 60 days. If they work together for five days, What fraction of the work will be left?
questions.solution:
A can do a work in 1 day = 1/30 part

⇒ A can do a work in 5 days = 5/30 = 1/6 part

⇒ B can do the same work in 1 day = 1/60 part

⇒ B can do the same work in 5 days = 5/60 = 1/12 part

⇒ Work done by A and B together in 5 days = 1/6 + 1/12 = 3/12 = 1/4 part

⇒ Remaining work = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4 part

∴ Remaining work is 3/4 part.

⇒ Time = Distance/speed

⇒ Time = 72/12 = 6 hours

∴ The boat can cover 72 km in 6 hours in still water.

questions.question: The difference in selling price of an article when it is sold at 20% profit and 18% loss is Rs 570. If it is sold at 12% loss, then what will be the selling price of the article?

CP = 1500

Required SP = 1500 × (100 - 12)/100 = Rs. 1320

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the cost price be 100x.

⇒ Selling price when sold at 12% profit = 100x × 120% = 120x

⇒ Selling price when sold at 18% loss = 100x × 82% = 82x

⇒ The difference in selling price when sold at 20% Profit and when sold at 18% Loss = 570

⇒ (120x - 82x) = 570

⇒ 38x = 570

⇒ 100x = 1500

⇒ Selling price when sold at 12% loss = cost price × (100 - 12)%

⇒ Selling price when sold at 12% loss = 1500 88% = Rs. 1320

∴ Selling price at 12% loss will be Rs. 1320.

• The movement focused on the annihilation of caste-based and gender-based inequality in society.

questions.question: How many amendments are there in Indian Constitution till March 2019?
questions.solution:

__

questions.question: Which of the following element is present in an antiperspirant deodorant?
questions.solution:

• Antiperspirant is a liquid/gel that is used to reduce sweating and perspiration.
 
• The Aluminium-based compounds are used because these compound form a temporary plug within the sweat duct that stops flow of sweat.
 
• When the Aluminium comes in contact with sweat it turns into a gel that forms plug over sweat gland.
 
• sweat is still produced in our body but it won't be released in the areas where antiperspirant has been applied.
 
• When an antiperspirant is applied, the salt dissolves the sweat or moisture in the underarm.

questions.question: In the year 1817 ______ tried to arrange elements with similar properties into groups.
questions.solution:
__**Dobereiner**__

 
• In 1817, a German chemist Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner arranged the elements with similar properties in a group. 
 
• Dobereiner Triad is based on three elements group. He was the first person who started grouping of elements on the basis of atomic weight.
 
• The three elements of the triad were arranged in such a manner that the atomic mass of the middle element was approximately the average of the atomic masses of the other two elements.
 
• For example:- Atomic weight of Li=7, Na=23, K=39&n
